name: GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Jurassic World Edition, Egg Case
description: The GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Jurassic World Dragon Egg Edition brings the Jurassic World license to one of GAN's most popular entry flagships, finished in a stickerless brown, green, and yellow colorway with the Jurassic World logo on the center cap and film-inspired detailing like claw scratches on the top face.
features: Collectible egg case: Ships inside a cracked dinosaur egg display case that makes the cube a gift and a shelf piece, not just a solve.
Proven GAN 356 ME platform: Built on GAN's popular entry flagship, so it turns like a real speed cube, not a novelty.
Magnetic feel: Faster, more accurate turning that clicks into place as you solve.
Magnetic positioning: Built-in magnets help each layer settle into alignment for cleaner, more controlled turns.
Stickerless build: Molded color panels won't peel or fade with use.
Themed detailing: Claw scratches on the top corner, the Jurassic World logo center, and licensed markings carry the theme across the whole cube.
